files.content:
# products-service

Inventory service.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

TypeScript on Node.js 24 with no runtime dependencies. Data is kept in memory, so run one
replica until a database replaces `src/store.ts`. A record that belongs to another (a
`<parent>_id` field) must point at one that exists, lists can be filtered by it, and
deleting the parent deletes its children.

## Run and test

```bash
npm install          # type checker and linter only
npm start            # http://localhost:8000
npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/products` | List products |
| `POST` | `/products` | Create a product |
| `GET` | `/products/{product_id}` | Get one product |
| `PATCH` | `/products/{product_id}` | Update a product |
| `DELETE` | `/products/{product_id}` | Delete a product |
| `GET` | `/shipments` | List shipments |
| `POST` | `/shipments` | Create a shipment |
| `GET` | `/shipments/{shipment_id}` | Get one shipment |
| `PATCH` | `/shipments/{shipment_id}` | Update a shipment |
| `DELETE` | `/shipments/{shipment_id}` | Delete a shipment |

Test helpers: an app on an ephemeral port

files.content:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
# Node runs the TypeScript sources directly; the image needs no build step and no
# node_modules (the project has no runtime dependencies).
FROM node:24-slim
ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=8000
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
COPY src ./src
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["node", "-e", "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz').then(r => process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1), () => process.exit(1))"]
CMD ["node", "src/server.ts"]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "24"
      - name: Install the type checker and linter
        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Type check
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Test
        run: npm test

  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: products-service:${{ github.sha }}

files.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: products-service
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: products-service
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: products-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: products-service
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: products-service:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: products-service-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
files.description: Deployment with probes, limits and a restricted security context
